performance_method: Absolute complete-cell-update rates for esm.md and six language controls, with median and observed min-max across twelve runs per condition
graph_policy: Assembly series and assembly-ratio axes are omitted from every visible performance graph. Raw controls remain in source data for provenance.
figure_unit_labels: Put units in square brackets on axes, colour bars and variable-label declarations. Keep plotted values, scales and ordinary value-unit expressions unchanged.

independent_plotted_input_reviews.method: Read-only comparison of all plotted groups and samples with accepted source records, including counts, grids, steps, labels, aggregation, ranges and cohorts

historical_controls: Six vanilla/tuned Fortran, Julia and compiled-Python controls from October 2026 appear alongside November 2026 esm.md. The visible date note separates these cohorts. CPU and GPU use separate timers.
scope: CPU timing uses wall time on one Neoverse V2 core. GPU timing uses device events on one GH200. These measure complete-update compute throughput, not end-to-end forecast time.
The six CPU median rates remain below the paired assembly controls, so this snapshot does not establish CPU parity.
Rates include complete numerical updates and exclude setup, verification and file output as recorded by each protocol.
Exact acceptance covers the recorded inputs and tested configurations, and does not establish x86 performance.
Physical figures are unchanged accepted canonical model states rather than observations.
The current esm.md and archived language controls use separate dates, nodes and jobs. Absolute rates preserve their recorded ranges, and are not freshly paired speedup estimates.

comparison_evidence.aggregation: Median of twelve individual rates, with observed minimum and maximum. No confidence interval or cross-cohort paired ratio is inferred.
scope: The cohorts use separate runs and nodes. Comparisons show recorded absolute rates and do not establish a freshly paired speedup.
CPU rates use complete-run wall time on one Neoverse V2 core. GPU rates use complete-graph CUDA event time on one GH200 device.
Compilation, setup and verification are excluded. GPU transfers and graph construction are also excluded.
The workload grids, batch lengths and retained input generators agree. Each cohort passed its own recorded physical and exact-output checks.
Python is compiled with Numba. These records do not describe interpreted Python.
